summary: Steep east kerb on a narrow residential street, with houses 13-17 m away.
reasons: Narrow street, little room beside lane

drivers.seclusion: Bush and a construction plot behind the kerb here, but houses 13-17 m away and more across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow street; cars park on the west side and at the north end, with little spare width on the east.
drivers.convention: No signs; some cars park on the street, no overnight-van convention.

flags: Steep: about 10.5% at best, mean 13.5%, max 22%
Narrow street, tight for a van at the kerb
sun_shade: Mature trees overhang the section from the east, shading it for most of the day.

best_section.where: East kerb of Beatrice Street, beside the bushy block past the new units
